Name: 22Trust Venture
Company description: Welcome to 22Trust Venture, the FINTECH Startup rebooting Retail banking to bring it to the XXIst century standards. We are a team of determined individuals, all sharing a vision for success. We believe that our sophisticated technology has the potential to renew the entire lending industry to the benefits of everyday people.

Name: Akcenta Romania
Company description: Akcenta is the financial institution that helps businesses maximize their profits by providing unbeatable transaction fees on exchange and foreign payments while offering lightning-speed service and unmatched customer experience. Headquartered in the Czech Republic and with over 51.000 customers in the portfolio, Akcenta is a reliable alternative to working with banks for currency exchange and international payments. Work with us for serious money savings on banking fees and commissions! Get: - tailored offer for your currency exchange needs - money transfers in minutes within some EU countries, maximum 2 hours - exceptional conditions on international payments (over 120 currencies) - outstanding customer support - while we use the latest technologies to support our business, we firmly believe that when dealing with money, you must be attended to by a competent consultant right away, so we won't wreck your nerves by asking you to press buttons, following endless AI assistants' instructions. - a modern and intuitive online platform to manage your transactions - quick onboarding with under 2 hours document verification process Akcenta is the first B2B fintech on the Romanian market, serving over 3.400 happy customers since 2014.  Akcenta has been a member of the RBI group since 2021.

Name: BitMahavi
Company description: bitMahavi reprezintă o soluție pragmatică pentru piața românească de monezi digitale. Cu peste 10 ani de experiență în Fintech am pornit un proiect orientat către clienți, dezvoltat din nevoile și interesele unei piețe încă în expansiune în România ce are nevoie de soluțiile noastre tehnologice.

Name: Business Capital
Company description: Platforma fintech accesscapital.ro a fost creată pentru a oferi soluții de finanțare online și accesul către lichidați pentru ține, într-o manieră modernă și ușoară. Pachetul de finanțare cuprinde factoring și microcreditare, afacerile mici fiind în centrul a ceea ce facem iar pentru această am gândit și creat soluții de finanțare specifice nevoilor  acestora, oferind aprobare  în timp real, integrat și cu documente  minime. Pentru a accesa soluțiile noastre de finanțare, am gândit o analiză foarte simplă a afacerii tale, flexibilă dar mai ales să fie rapidă, combinând tehnologia de azi cu expertiză și cunoașterea dobândită în anii trecuți. Știm că timpul unui antreprenor este foarte important și facem eforturi să răspundem solicitărilor în câteva ore, iar plata contractelor să fie în maxim 24 ore de la aprobare. Suportul este asigurat de către o echipa de profesioniști, cu experiență îndelungată de peste 20 ani în domeniul financiar - bancar iar printr-o abordare fintech urmărim eliminarea dezavantajelor sistemului de finanțare clasic. Înțelegem foarte bine afacea ta, vino să ne cunoști !

Name: EcoFinance Romania
HQ Location: Romania, Bucureşti, Bucharest, No.54a Building Av. Popișteanu
Company description: A company with a Fintech philosophy. We develop and introduce advanced online lending products, providing friendly service based on international best practice. Following the success of EcoFinance, EcoFinance Romania branch was founded in 2017 by a professional team with a wealth of experience in banking and investment. This experience became the basis for developing new loan products, whose usability fulfils the demands of the digital generation. Innovative EcoFinance loan products allow clients to take out a loan online in just a few minutes—securely, with no need to visit a branch.  In product development, we adhere to the world’s top industry standards and root principles of responsible lending. Our goal is to design and bring to international markets financial services that will become leaders in their respective niches. ------ O companie cu o filozofie Fintech. Dezvoltăm și aducem pe piață produse avansate de creditare online, oferind servicii perfect adaptate nevoilor consumatorilor, și care se bazează pe cele mai bune practici internaționale. În urma succesului înregistrat de compania EcoFinance, filiala EcoFinance România a fost înființată în 2017, de către o echipă de profesioniști, cu o bogată experiență în domeniul bancar și al investițiilor. Această experiență a devenit baza pentru dezvoltarea de noi produse de creditare, a căror utilizare satisface cerințele generației digitale. Produsele inovatoare oferite de EcoFinance permit clienților să încheie un împrumut online în doar câteva minute - sigur, fără a fi nevoie să viziteze o sucursală.  În dezvoltarea produselor noastre, aderăm la standardele industriale de top din lume și respectăm principiile de creditare responsabilă. Scopul nostru este de a proiecta și a aduce pe piețele internaționale servicii financiare de succes, care sa ajungă în top în zona de nișă pe care o abordează.

Name: Finqware
HQ Location: Romania, Bucureşti, Bucharest, 21 Elena Caragiani Street 8, 014212
Company description: Finqware is a European fintech infrastructure provider, licensed as a Payment Institution, helping companies and financial institutions automate treasury operations, gain seamless access to pan-European banking data, and embrace next-generation Account-to-Account payments. By leveraging Open Banking technology, we deliver real-time visibility, connectivity, and innovation across cash management, data aggregation, and digital payments. Finqware helps CFOs and their teams automate their work through its FinqTreasury platform, a Treasury Management Automation solution for multi-entity cross-border organisations, by providing real-time cash management, payments, collections & reporting on top of Open Banking.

Name: Fintech Camp
Company description: Fintech Camp is a network of local grassroots movements bringing people closer to fintech - by bringing fintech in their community. We organise regular meetups in 9 cities across Romania, Moldova, Hungary, Finland, Croatia and Germany. Want to start a community in your town? Drop us a line at hello@fintech.camp.

Name: HeyBlu
Company description: Founded in 2023, HeyBlu is a fintech company aiming to become a regional player in Central and Eastern Europe. The company’s goal is to develop flexible and transparent financing services using Romanian technology, enabling customers to enjoy the benefits of online shopping through new financing tools that enhance their purchasing power in a simple and convenient way, based on fair and transparent lending rules. HeyBlu is part of the eMAG Group, is regulated by the National Bank of Romania (BNR), and is one of the financial service providers available on eMAG.

Name: ICredit Romania
HQ Location: Romania, Bucureşti, Bucharest, Nr. 67 Str. Logofat Tautu
Company description: iCredit este de 13 ani unul din principalii jucători din piața financiară nebancară din România, având 115 puncte de lucru și peste 1400 de angajați în întreaga țară. Compania face parte din Management Financial Group (MFG) care reunește furnizori fintech si insuretech din Europa Centrală.  MFG gestionează un portofoliu divers de modele de afaceri de succes: credite de consum, împrumuturi pentru microîntreprinderi și întreprinderi mici, carduri de credit, digital business, asigurări, investiții P2P și alte produse și servicii financiare alternative. Peste 8300 de angajați și colaboratori, prezenți în aproximativ 450 de birouri în Bulgaria, România, Croația, Polonia, Macedonia de Nord și Spania oferă servicii financiare clienților MFG. Grupul are în plan extinderea și pe alte piețe cum ar fi Germania, Mexic, India și Statele Unite.

Name: Lendrise
Company description: Lendrise Marketplace is a fintech who strongly believes in digital identity, creditworthiness, and health so that people can store and use personal information in their best interests and beyond any political, social, financial, or geographical boundaries. Lendrise is founder member of the rofin.tech 🇷🇴

Name: Minutizer
Company description: Our business story: Minutizer is a dynamic, multicultural fintech company with over 13 years of experience, offering a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C products across multiple brands and industries, including telemedicine, esotericism, content creation, and adult entertainment. From the outset, our vision was to become the leading money-streaming company. As we've grown, we have refined our mission to better enhance the value we create for our customers and the unique needs of our business verticals and products. Looking ahead, we stay dedicated to what we do best - creating seamless payment solutions where real human connections flourish.  Our team: We are a diverse team of 50 talented professionals spanning over five countries and three continents. We thrive on diversity, value co-creation, and take pride in building great memories together both in and outside of work. Our values: This is what we value most:  Analytical & Direct: We analyze rationally and communicate with clarity.  Self-driven: We take ownership, act proactively, and overcome challenges.  Knowledgeable: We apply expertise to solve complex problems effectively.  Always kind, especially with our users: We prioritize kindness and empathy in every interaction.  Flexible but never harming anyone: We adapt while ensuring ethical and considerate actions.   Always open to healthy counterarguments: We value constructive discussions and diverse well-argued perspectives.

Name: Mogo România
Company description: Mogo is a vehicle financier offering tailor-made loan solutions for the mobility needs of individuals and companies. Mogo operates in Romania since 2016 and is a part of Eleving Group - an international FinTech founded in 2012 and currently operating in 14 countries across three continents with a team of more than 2 600 professionals. Eleving Group has been recognized on the Financial Times’ list of Europe’s 1 000 fastest growing companies in 2020 and 2021.

Name: Ocean Credit IFN
Company description: Ocean Credit was founded in 2015 as an IFN with a strong technology component and a desire to change the Romanians’ perception regarding classic lending institutions. We are among the pioneers of digital lending in Romania, the first to bring card2card credit transfer technology to the local market, automating the entire lending process, from a KYC (know your customer) based on Facebook account, to instant money transfer on the salary card, as well as being the first to offer free online access to FICO score. Our mission is to transform complex financial information into simple data that can help people save money and time when they borrow. Time and experience are the decisive factors that differentiate a Fintech from a Bank. Users can access a loan in less than 8 minutes, thanks to 3 main services: risk management based on machine learning, instant money transfer card2card, and FICO score analytics. Ocean Credit products are simple and easy to understand, presented under friendly names like Pinguin with a limit of 4.500 lei, the Delfin credit line up to 9.000 lei, and Coral with a limit of 12.000 lei accessible exclusively online, 24/7. To this date, Ocean Credit has provided loans worth over 9 million euros out of more than 43,000 contracts.

Name: Open2Cash
Company description: Open2Cash is a young Romanian company which operates in the ATM networks industry. Our ATMs are placed in strategic locations, meant to give our customers instant access to cash. Open2Cash has a strong digital core and a fintech DNA, but it also recognizes the power of cash in today’s fast-paced world. The need of cash is not going away anytime soon, and we made it our mission to bring you the convenience of paying with physical money whenever you need to do so.

Name: PayByFace
Company description: More convenient shopping experience with extra-low investment?  Create a frictionless check-out experience: faster transactions (“avoid me waiting”) and valuable rewards (“make me count”) to strengthen loyalty and boost turnover.  Enable shoppers to “make purchases with a selfie”, without cash, card, or phone, providing a global payment, loyalty & DOOH ecosystem, powered by PayByFace. What Faster and Valuable mean? 1sec authentication, below 5sec payment transactions, instant loyalty points allocation or redeem, personalized up-sell or cross-sell offers using proprietary insightful merchant CRM dashboard, cross-traffic and branding DOOH. Wish for more? open to hearing from you. Shoppers create unique digital eWallet using face as a highly secured virtual card (4 simultaneous points of transaction validation vs up to 1 while using card or cash). The user is in full CONTROL of data and activity. Only a secured encrypted number is submitted to the nearby merchant network to match on authentication, if he wants it, of course.  An Innovative Cardless Payment method for the whole family or even for each business team member. One card linked, individual budget allowances, instant receipts and transactions overview, instant loyalty points allocation or redeem, on the spot valuable personalized offers. Wish for more? we’ve built it for you.  Reach out for more insights. PayByFace® is a B2B2C fintech start-up, with an experienced EU leadership team, to facilitate low to no-touch payment transactions (in-store or remote), loyalty programs (improved KYC and built-in CRM), and OOH digital advertising ecosystem.

Name: Paysera Romania
Company description: Paysera is a FinTech company which offers online payment services to companies & individuals. The company provides free multicurrency payment account - e-wallet, which enables making and receiving money transfers to and from more than 180 worldwide in more than 25 different currencies, exchanging currencies at favourable rates, collecting payments in e-shops & POS. The price of outgoing transfers via Paysera is as low as 0.15 EUR for euro transfers to EU for business clients. For individuals, the first 30 transfers each month are free of charge. Incoming transfers in EUR are also free of charge for both - individuals & companies. The account has its mobile application which enables funds management whenever and whereever you are, mobile payments with QR codes, instant free transfers to other Paysera users. Other services of Paysera include Paysera payment card for cheap euro payments in the EU,  payment gateway service for online shops, ticketing system for event organizers as well as cashless mobile payments with QR codes for retailers at POS.

Name: Romanian Fintech Association
Company description: Founded in 2020, the Romanian Fintech Association is a professional entrepreneurial organisation focused on helping fintech startups and scaleups expand internationally, and bringing more people into the space of fintech.

Name: Salt Bank
HQ Location: Romania, Bucureşti, Bucharest, Nr. 5-7 Bd. Dimitrie Pompeiu, et.6
Company description: Suntem primul neobank 100% românesc.  O bancă pentru cei care nu stau în banca lor. Care vor mereu mai mult.  Care nu merg înainte pas cu pas. Ci salt după salt.

Name: SelfPay
Company description: ⏫ SelfPay is a fast growing fintech leading the electronic payment solutions field, running the largest network of self-service payment stations in Europe and promoting financial inclusion for all social categories, making their life easier and enjoyable. ▶Already serving 7 million households, SelfPay processes over 2 million transactions monthly and build an ecosystem of smart financial services that payments easy for anybody.  We have long-standing partnerships with major utility providers & the telecom industry, as well as financial institutions and public authorities so that the SelfPay payment stations becomes a one-stop-shop for all the payment needs pf our users.  ⏩Currently, our self-service payment stations are to be found in large retail networks, commercial centers, markets, gas stations and convenience stores  and our network will expand in more European countries in the following years.  ✔ We are a proud member of The Romanian Fintech Association (RoFin.Tech), a professional entrepreneurial association that represents the interests of local companies building proprietary technology products.

Name: SelfPay Now
Company description: SelfPay Now is an innovative fintech started in Romania, part of the SelfPay Group. Under the same brand, the company has developed a mobile app that seamlessly links cash and online payments, allowing users to deposit cash instantly on any card. SelfPay Now also helps users to transfer money between them in real time, with just a couple of screen taps. SelfPay Now is one of the most flexible financial apps available in Romania, soon to roll out in multiple countries across Europe; the expansion comes with a multitude of extra options that will cater to increasingly more diversified financial needs of its users. SelfPay Now originates with one of the most appreciated fintech companies in Romania: SelfPay, a role model for the local business community. The company, a leading self-service payment terminal operator with over 9.000 units operating nationwide, was listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange in 2021 with a private placement of corporate bonds.

Name: Smart Fintech
Company description: With Smart Fintech, financial departments in mid-sized to large companies manage their cash in real time through always-on bank connections, simplify third-party payments (without juggling payment files), and gain actionable insights from intelligent reporting — all powered by open banking, the new frontier in modern finance management. About us Smart Fintech is breaking barriers in Romania as the first authorized open banking Third Party Provider (TPP) by the National Bank of Romania (NBR) in 2021.  We deliver innovative solutions through our key API offerings – SmartPay for A2A payments (supporting corporate B2B transactions and any payment scenario within the broad eCommerce space) and Smart Accounts for digitalized bank account information. We're all about innovation, collaboration, and excellence in the local open banking landscape. These two core solutions form the foundation of our SaaS platform for real-time cash management, the Smart Accounts App. Seamlessly connect your ERP or core business system to our platform to transform your reconciliations and enhance your financial operations. Smart Fintech is a payment institution authorized by the National Bank of Romania, listed in the Register of Payment Institutions and Specialized Providers of Account Information Services under no. IP-RO-0011/02.04.2021.

Name: UNCHAIN Festival
HQ Location: Romania, Bihor, Oradea, 41 Piața Emanuil Gojdu, 410100
Company description: UNCHAIN Festival is a unique opportunity for bankers, financial institutions, technology providers, startups, investors, and all other relevant stakeholders of the CEE ecosystem to discuss the latest trends, create business opportunities and spark innovation in fintech & blockchain. We invite all fintech enthusiasts to join us for an electric experience in Oradea between 17-18 June 2025. See more about the Festival on https://unchainfestival.com and get an early registration.

Name: United Payment Romania
HQ Location: Romania, Bucureşti, Bucharest, Nr. 4b 2-4 Ing. George Constantinescu
Company description: United Payment Romania is derived by Birleşik Ödeme Hizmetleri ve E-Para A.Ş. Birleşik Ödeme Hizmetleri ve E-Para A.Ş. is a payment services company that offers a wide range of products and advantages to its clients and business partners with its innovative, practical, reliable and distinguished solutions based on its Fintech-as-a-Service platform infrastructure.  United Payment(Birlesik Odeme) support corporates in terms of digital & financial transformation and help them provide financial products to their own channels with their own brand and generate new revenue channels by using the latest smart payment technologies.
